# proxmox_sdn_rollback (Resource)

Rolls the staged Proxmox VE SDN configuration back to the running snapshot through `POST /cluster/sdn/rollback`. This discards every uncommitted change on the cluster, so it is a separate opt-in step next to `proxmox_sdn_apply` (which commits). Destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Discards every staged SDN change by restoring the running snapshot.
# Use it as an explicit "throw the staging away" step; destroying the resource
# does not re-apply anything. Credentials need SDN.Allocate on /sdn.
resource "proxmox_sdn_rollback" "discard" {
  triggers = {
    revision = "2026-11-03"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when a rollback is due; changing any of them re-runs it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier.
- `remaining_pending` (List of String) Pending objects Proxmox still reports after the rollback, formatted as `<type> <id> (<state>)`.
- `remaining_pending_zones` (Map of String) Pending zones keyed by zone id after the rollback.
